newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse suspends trading in four stocks.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse suspends trading in four stocks.

text.p: Athens bourse authorities ordered a two-day suspension in trading of four stocks which have been linked to the settlement scandal which shut down the exchange for almost four days.
The bourse suspended trade on Thursday and Friday in Magrizos, Parnassos, Hellenic Sugar Industry and St George Mills, a bourse statement said.
"The suspension is not related to the companies or their economic situations but is to facilitate any possible checks being conducted on transactions in their shares to date," the statement said.
The national economy ministry has ordered an audit of 10 brokerages.

The order came after one brokerage, Delta Securities, tried to settle at the bourse clearing house with bad checks. That led to an uproar by the brokers' association which demanded that the government guarantee future settlements.

The brokers association (SMEHA) groups all 65 brokerages which are registered to trade on the exchange. SMEHA members refused to trade for almost four days, effectively closing the exchange, until the scandal was investigated.
Delta's failure to pay 2.6 billion drachmas in settlements has been linked to its trading in Magrizos shares. Delta has been charged with fraud and its accounts and assets frozen.
